s:
Match the following Governor of the Indian State (List-1) with their respective States (List-2) as of March 2025.
Governor (List-1):
A. Shri Acharya Dev Vrat
B. Shri Bandaru Dattatraya
C. Shri Shiv Pratap Shukla
States (List-2):
1. Gujarat
2. Himachal Pradesh
3. Haryana
x:
Bandaru Dattatreya was replaced in Haryana by Prof. Ashim Kumar Ghosh (appointed 14 July 2025, sworn in 21 July 2025), and Shiv Pratap Shukla moved from Himachal Pradesh to Telangana in March 2026 (Kavinder Gupta now Governor of HP); Acharya Devvrat is still Governor of Gujarat (Praveen CA-360 Mar 2026 p.16, p.52; Rocket CA 2026 Part 01 p.42; tribuneindia.com 14 Jul 2025)
As of March 2025, Acharya Devvrat was Governor of Gujarat, Bandaru Dattatreya of Haryana (since July 2021) and Shiv Pratap Shukla of Himachal Pradesh, so A-1, B-3, C-2. Option A wrongly puts Dattatreya in Himachal (his post in 2019–21, not 2025). (Now Haryana's Governor is Prof. Ashim Kumar Ghosh, and Shukla is Governor of Telangana.)
